insights.summary: H1 FY26 revenue was only ₹50 Cr with an 11% EBITDA margin and 2.9% PAT margin, because Navy shipyards schedule most deliveries in H2 and the company front-loaded hiring (247 to 323 people). Management guided FY26 revenue of ₹140-150 Cr, a 20-22% EBITDA margin and a 13-15% PAT margin, and 40-50% annual growth for four to five years from a ₹327 Cr order book and a ~₹1,000 Cr bid pipeline to March 2027. It is entering data-centre cooling through a partnership with Smardt (oil-free chillers), with major revenue expected from FY28.

what_changed.text: FY26 revenue ₹140-150 Cr with PAT margin similar to FY25
EBITDA margin guided at 20-22% (FY24-25: 27-31%) as spares share fell
Data-centre cooling via Smardt partnership; major revenue from FY28
Order book ₹327 Cr after ₹162 Cr of new orders in H1

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: We are expected to grow around 40% to 50% CAGR rates for next four to five years easily.

analyst_questions.answer: Shipyards take most deliveries in H2 (70%); a second rented factory and more staff added.
Spares fell from ~40% to ~8% of revenue; on-site execution costs.
Smardt is already approved by hyperscalers; Shree provides local support and service near cable-landing cities.
Naval HVAC is ~0.5-0.9% of a ship's cost; Shree wins 50%+ among 3-4 players.

red_flags.text: Very lumpy half-yearly revenue tied to shipyard schedules.
Fixed-price contracts expose margins to raw-material costs.
Data-centre business initially commission plus service only.

watch_next: H2 FY26 revenue (~₹90-100 Cr needed for guidance)
New plant start in early FY27

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Air-conditioning plants, refrigeration plants, ship HVAC systems and control panels for Indian Navy warships and submarines; test equipment for refrigeration makers
business_snapshot.customers: Indian Navy and shipyards (Mazagon Dock, GRSE, Hindustan Shipyard, Cochin Shipyard), retrofit programmes; refrigeration OEMs for test rigs
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26: new-build and retrofit systems; retrofit ~32%; spares ~8%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Navy fleet expansion, indigenisation, retrofits, merchant shipbuilding, data-centre cooling
